details.painting: Held by the Word- Be Still and Know that I am God
details.selection_rule_reason: painting-catalog.json's own 'used' lists show Atelier=6, Studio=4, but post 012 ('In the Cradle of Faith', a Studio painting, run 2026-08-24) postdates the catalog's 2026-08-21 snapshot and isn't reflected there. Verified directly against post 012's own files and excluded it from this run's candidate pool. Real counts: Atelier=6, Studio=5. Studio still has fewer used entries, so the selection rule still points to Studio (not a tie; tiebreaker not needed).
details.egress_status: www.wholeheartedarts.com and images.squarespace-cdn.com both confirmed blocked this run (one untried-retry test each, per instructions: a WebFetch to the site returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, and a curl to the image CDN returned 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'). Painting facts came from painting-catalog.json (live Squarespace API data as of 2026-08-21). Image could not be downloaded/cropped; raw public image_url used as fallback wherever an image URL was needed (Buffer's own servers fetched it independently and it attached successfully to all three Buffer entries, 2000x1334).
details.scripture_verification: Psalm 37:7 and Psalm 46:10 both independently verified via WebSearch (ESV.org, BibleHub, Biblia) since direct fetch to biblegateway.com/biblehub.com/esv.org is also blocked by the egress proxy. Confirms the painting's Psalm 37 attribution is distinct from and not confused with the more famous Psalm 46:10 'be still' verse. See research.md and fact-check.md.

history.event: 2026-09-30: Buffer staging corrected. Root cause of the 'Instagram-only drafts' problem: Instagram drafts were created with schedulingType 'notification' (Buffer Reminders), which can only be published from the Buffer mobile app; LinkedIn/Facebook were parked on the Ideas board, not in Drafts. Direct test proved schedulingType 'automatic' + saveToDraft true yields a genuinely inert draft on all three channels. Instagram draft switched to automatic; LinkedIn idea converted to a real Buffer draft. Facebook is no longer staged separately: Agata's Instagram account cross-posts to the Facebook Page.
